//: Every route ouroboros-ui serves — each page.tsx under app/(app), app/(auth) and app/(wizard) — mapped to the doc page that documents it (its path under docs/, without the extension), or to {"undocumented": "<reason>"}. Workshop routes are always undocumented. yarn check:coverage holds this file to the routes and the pages (DE.4, #1212).

/.undocumented: redirects to /dashboard, or to /login when signed out; nothing to read

/workshop/charts.undocumented: a developer workshop for the chart components; not a product screen

/workshop/chrome.undocumented: a developer workshop for the app chrome; not a product screen

/workshop/providers-audit.undocumented: a developer workshop for the providers audit; not a product screen

/workshop/settings-save.undocumented: a developer workshop for the settings save flow; not a product screen
